_comment: Mutation testing proves the tests are connected to the code. Scoped to TypeScript: Stryker cannot instrument .svelte files, so it targets the actions, constants and icon registry where the logic lives.
_comment_thresholds: break sits just under the achieved score. a11ySync, deviceMotion, viewTransition and constants are at 100%; dragSnap's remaining survivors are equivalent mutants (layered guards that cover each other, and boundaries where both branches compute the same value). swipeActions is newer and at ~78%, which is what holds the total down - raise break to 95 once it catches up.
